# @agents-js/wake-channel-bridge

> Gateway-side composition: pulls pending wake signals from @agents-js/wake-signal-store, emits them via @agents-js/claude-channel-adapter, marks delivered on success. Closes the AJS-89 HYBRID SOURCE → CC receiver loop per ADR-0007 revision.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/wake-channel-bridge
```

## API

<!-- Auto-generated from JSDoc -->

### Functions

- **`createWakeChannelBridge`** — Construct a wake channel bridge over the store + adapter + resolvers. ```ts const bridge = createWakeChannelBridge({ store: createWakeSignalStore({ backend: new InMemoryWakeSignalStoreBackend() }),...

### Interfaces

- **`BridgeDrainResult`** — Summary of a drain pass. `attempts` is in store-order (createdAtMs ascending — the same order the store returns).
- **`BridgeResolvers`** — Caller-supplied mapping from a stored wake signal record to the channel-message fields the adapter emits. Caller knows the semantic meaning of their wake payload; the bridge doesn't.
- **`WakeChannelBridge`** — Wake channel bridge handle. Caller drives drain/dispatch primitives; an external scheduler decides cadence.
- **`WakeChannelBridgeDeps`** — Dependencies for {createWakeChannelBridge}.

### Types

- **`BridgeAttemptResult`** — Result of attempting to drain a single signal through the bridge. Discriminated union: caller can `switch` on `outcome` with `assertNever`-enforced exhaustiveness.


## Dependencies

- `@agents-js/wake-signal-store`
- `@agents-js/claude-channel-adapter`
- `@agents-js/wake-types`
